site_url.description: The verified property exactly as registered in Search Console: 'sc-domain:example.com' for a domain property, or the full URL-prefix including scheme and trailing slash (e.g. 'https://www.example.com/'). The snapshot's source_properties carries the API's own siteUrl form verbatim.

credentials_file.description: Path to a service-account JSON key file; the account must be added as a user of the property. A reference only - key material never lives in config files.

credentials_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the service-account key JSON (the content, not a path). Same indirection pattern as the postgres connector's dsn_env.
